clauses.title: Collision coverage
clauses.text: We pay for direct and accidental collision loss to a covered auto when it hits another vehicle or object, subject to the deductible and the actual cash value limit.

clauses.title: Comprehensive coverage
clauses.text: We pay for direct and accidental comprehensive loss that is not a collision, including theft, vandalism, fire, hail, windstorm, and contact with an animal.

clauses.title: Liability coverage
clauses.text: We pay damages for bodily injury or property damage that an insured is legally liable to pay because of an auto accident.

clauses.title: Intentional loss
clauses.text: We do not cover any loss caused intentionally by an insured or at an insured's direction.

clauses.title: Racing
clauses.text: We do not cover loss arising from a race, speed contest, or practice for a race, whether organized or informal.

clauses.title: Wear and breakdown
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by wear and tear, mechanical breakdown, electrical breakdown, or gradual deterioration.

clauses.title: Commercial use
clauses.text: We do not cover loss while a covered auto carries persons or property for a fee or is otherwise used for a commercial rideshare purpose.

clauses.title: Aftermarket electronics sublimit
clauses.text: Aftermarket electronic equipment that the manufacturer did not permanently install, including audio and video systems, is covered only up to a 1000 dollar sublimit.

clauses.title: Theft police report
clauses.text: Theft coverage applies only when a police report is filed and the report is available before we pay the theft claim.

clauses.title: Limit and deductible
clauses.text: The most we pay for a covered auto loss is the limit or actual cash value, whichever is less, minus a 500 dollar collision deductible or a 250 dollar comprehensive deductible.

clauses.title: Sudden water discharge
clauses.text: We cover sudden and accidental discharge of water from a plumbing, heating, or appliance system inside the dwelling.

clauses.title: Fire and smoke
clauses.text: We cover sudden loss to the dwelling caused by fire or smoke.

clauses.title: Personal property theft
clauses.text: We cover theft of personal property from the residence premises.

clauses.title: Flood
clauses.text: We do not cover loss from flood, surface water, waves, or water that backs up through a sewer or drain.

clauses.title: Earth movement
clauses.text: We do not cover loss from earth movement, including earthquake, landslide, or subsidence.

clauses.title: Mold
clauses.text: We do not cover mold or mildew, except the tear-out cost that follows a covered sudden water discharge, and mold remediation above that cost is excluded.

clauses.title: Intentional loss

clauses.title: Neglect
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by neglect of the insured to save and preserve property after a loss.
